iam:AddClientIDToOpenIDConnectProvider.note: Explicitly denied by the DenyPrincipalCreation statement of the deploy-iam policy: OIDC providers are bootstrap/customer owned. The aws_iam_openid_connect_provider resource the IAM role driver can emit for EKS workload trust therefore cannot be applied through the deploy role; the cluster's OIDC provider must be created by the customer stack.
